//: semantic-release for a module that is NOT a Node package. There is no package.json
here and @semantic-release/npm is deliberately absent: the version record is
module.json, because that is the file the main repo's check_compatibility.py fetches
to answer which version this module is. @semantic-release/exec writes it through
The release rules match the main repository's on purpose - a `refactor:` is a patch
in both, so one commit convention covers every repository in this project.
This module publishes no wiki: it has no _docs/ yet. When the control side lands and
_docs/ appears, add the wiki gate and the wiki job to .github/workflows/release.yml
the way the Beckhoff module has them - not here.

plugins.//: prepare, so the write happens before @semantic-release/git stages it. Run from the repository root, which is where the workflow checks this module out.
